name: Vanilla syrup
description: One of the most common coffee syrups. It adds gentle sweetness and a distinct vanilla aroma.

name: Caramel syrup
flavorProfile: Sweet, with notes of caramelized sugar
description: Adds sweetness and caramel notes to a drink. It pairs well with milk-based coffee drinks.

name: Hazelnut syrup
description: A syrup with a hazelnut aroma. It brings out nutty notes in coffee and pairs well with milk.

name: Cinnamon syrup
description: Adds a warm, spicy note to a drink. It is often chosen for autumn coffee drinks.

name: Raspberry syrup
description: A raspberry-flavored syrup most commonly used in cold drinks.

name: Chocolate syrup
flavorProfile: Sweet, with a rich chocolate flavor
description: Adds a chocolate flavor to a drink. It is often used to make mocha.

name: Coconut syrup
description: A syrup with a distinct coconut aroma. It works well in cold drinks and coffee with milk.
